original_test_intent: For each approved second-DIMM/channel target, change the ECC leaky-bucket setting, perform the vendor-approved bounded injection, and verify register behavior plus correlated host and BMC SEL reporting.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Enter BIOS, edit ECC Leaky Bucket Threshold, save/reset, then verify DIMM_B injection behavior and logs.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Register behavior matches the platform expectation and second DIMM/DIMM_B still triggers system and BMC SEL records.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly treated BIOS interaction and error injection as operator-driven.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY because injection and BIOS activity cannot be performed through the generic OS path.
historical_reviews.v3: Kept MANUAL ONLY and added topology, SOP, restoration and evidence controls.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: A qualified engineer identifies each physical target, changes BIOS, performs the approved injection and confirms recovery; agent assistance is limited to evidence collection/correlation.
required_user_inputs: Vendor injection SOP/tool and bounded stimulus

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: Second-DIMM/all-channel leaky-bucket and logging intent is retained; the source supplies no portable slot map or threshold.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Board topology, approved channel matrix, vendor method, values, limits and recovery.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Testing fewer mapped channels is a project-scope reduction that must be reported; log collection alone cannot replace injection/BIOS behavior.

original_method: Preserve the BIOS leaky-bucket change and physical second-DIMM scope; commands/tool semantics remain vendor- and platform-specific and must not be guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the applicable vendor RAS SOP/tool for the exact board/CPU/firmware and let the agent automate only read-only baselines, synchronized log capture and matrix completeness checks.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable vendor/platform memory-RAS documentation or approved SOP is required.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original: Adds target mapping, bounded stimulus, synchronized evidence and configuration restoration without replacing the tested BIOS function.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Agent-assisted collection does not make the core operator-owned injection automatic.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong topology or uncontrolled injection can cause uncorrectable errors, event storms, no-boot or data loss.

safety_boundaries: Qualified operator only; isolated no-workload SUT.
Never guess registers, labels or injection commands and never clear logs.
Stop on wrong-target event, UCE, corruption, no-boot, event storm or loss of control.
expected_evidence: Correlated host RAS and BMC SEL events plus normal-boot/recovery evidence
no_automatic_retry: Every failed, mislocalized or uncontrolled stimulus is preserved. No additional injection, reset or recovery attempt occurs outside the approved matrix.
engineer_owned_verdict: Agent may flag incomplete or mismatched evidence; qualified engineering owns target validity, safety decisions and formal outcome.
review_improvement: V3 already made the correct classification. V3.1 explicitly explains why automation of log collection does not change a core BIOS/injection activity from MANUAL ONLY and why one engineer's approval cannot waive physical-target or recovery checks.
